features.title: Easy POS for shops | YeboMart
features.description: Tap or scan items, check the total and finish the sale. YeboMart keeps sales and stock together.
features.headline: An easy till for your shop.
features.intro:
Tap or scan the items, check the total and finish the sale. Your sales and stock stay together.

Find the receipt again when you or a customer needs it.
paragraphs: Tap or scan the items, check the total and finish the sale. Your sales and stock stay together.

benefits.title: An easy till
benefits.body: Choose the items and check the total before finishing the sale.

benefits.title: Stock stays connected
benefits.body: Keep the sale with the change in your stock count.

benefits.title: See who made the sale
benefits.body: Cashiers use their own access, so you can find the staff name on a sale.

steps: Record the payment and finish the sale.
features.limitations: Payment methods and receipt options depend on your shop’s setup.
features.example: A cashier chooses the items, checks the total and finishes the sale. The shop can find that sale again with its stock and receipt details.
features.availability: Available features depend on your account and setup.

video.title: An easy way to run your shop.
video.transcript:
Are you running a shop? YeboMart puts your till and stock together. Tap or scan the items, check the total and finish the sale. An easy POS for your shop.

Smart stock tracking helps you see what is left. Enter new goods as they arrive. Switch on WhatsApp updates to know what is running low.

At closing, count and enter the cash. Check any difference against the day’s sales. Open YeboMart for an easy way to run your shop.

features.title: Smart stock tracking | YeboMart
features.description: Follow your stock and new deliveries. Switch on daily WhatsApp low-stock updates when your plan allowance covers them.
features.headline: See what is left. Know what needs buying.
features.intro:
See what is left as goods sell, and add new stock when it arrives.

Switch on daily WhatsApp low-stock updates to see which items need attention. Messages depend on your shop settings and available allowance.
paragraphs: See what is left as goods sell, and add new stock when it arrives.
Switch on daily WhatsApp low-stock updates to see which items need attention. Messages depend on your shop settings and available allowance.

benefits.title: See what is left
benefits.body: Follow the stock count and the sales behind it.

benefits.title: Add what arrived
benefits.body: Enter the goods actually received, even if the amount differs from the order.

benefits.title: WhatsApp what is running low
benefits.body: Turn on daily low-stock updates in shop settings. Messages use your available plan allowance.

steps: Follow the sales and stock count.
Switch on WhatsApp updates when your allowance covers them.
features.limitations: WhatsApp updates must be switched on and have available message allowance. Stock counts depend on the details you enter.
features.example: If fewer cartons arrive than expected, enter the amount received. Check what is running low before buying more.

features.title: Count the cash at closing | YeboMart
features.description: Enter the opening cash, count the drawer at closing and check any difference in YeboMart.
features.headline: Count the cash. Check that it matches.
features.intro:
Enter the cash in the drawer when you open the till. At closing, count it and compare it with what the till expects.

If the figures differ, check the day’s sales and changes. Staff names help you find who made each entry.
paragraphs: Enter the cash in the drawer when you open the till. At closing, count it and compare it with what the till expects.
If the figures differ, check the day’s sales and changes. Staff names help you find who made each entry.

benefits.title: Start with the opening cash
benefits.body: Enter the amount actually put in the drawer.

benefits.title: Count at closing
benefits.body: Enter the money counted and compare it with the expected cash.

benefits.title: Check a difference
benefits.body: Look through the sales, refunds and changes that need explaining.

steps: Count and enter the closing cash.
features.limitations: A difference is a reason to check the sales, not proof that someone took money.
features.example: At closing, count the drawer. If the cash does not match, check the sales and refunds before deciding what needs correcting.
